paragraphs.text: Bringer is a creature type unique to Fifth Dawn . Bringers are depicted as crystalline humanoid or beastly entities. The Bringers are manifestations of the energy of the five "suns" (moons) of Mirrodin , and their nature transcends the metal ecology of the plane.
As a creature type used for a single cycle, Bringer has appeared once in each color .

Bringer was used for a cycle of rare creatures in Fifth Dawn (see below). It is no longer supported as a creature type. It was used to unify a group of creatures, but the type has not been added to creatures thereafter.
During an Unknown Event , a playtest card featuring the type was introduced: Bringer of Green Zenith's Twilight , which was also a Phyrexian .
Fifth Dawn contained a single cycle of Bringers.

Each of these creatures has a mana cost of MM, but can be played for instead of the mana cost. Each has base power and toughness 5/5, trample and a powerful ability that may be played at the beginning of the owner's upkeep.
